description: Web search through your Google Programmable Search Engine (Custom Search JSON API). Returns query, total_results (Google's estimate — it can shrink while paging), search_time_seconds, corrected_query (spelling suggestion; results are still for the original query), next_start/previous_start page cursors, and items[] with title, url, display_link, snippet, mime/file_format and (with include_pagemap) pagemap metadata. Coverage is the engine's configuration: an engine listing specific sites searches only those; open-web search needs "Search the entire web" enabled in its control panel — results still differ from google.com. Max 10 results per call and 100 per query: paginate by passing next_start as start. Each call costs one unit of the daily quota (free tier 100/day), so prefer one precise query over many broad ones. Note: this is Programmable Search, NOT Google Search Console — it cannot report how your own site is indexed or ranked.

country.description: Geolocation bias — rank results as if searching from this country, e.g. "de". Soft signal.

country_restrict.description: Hard filter — only documents Google attributes to this country, e.g. "DE".

date_restrict.description: Only results from the last N days/weeks/months/years: "d7", "w2", "m6", "y1", ...

engine_id.description: Programmable Search Engine id (cx) to search with, overriding the configured GOOGLE_CUSTOM_SEARCH_ENGINE_ID. Omit to use the configured engine.

exact_terms.description: A phrase every result must contain.

exclude_terms.description: A word or phrase no result may contain.

file_type.description: Only files of this type, e.g. "pdf", "xlsx", "svg".

filter_duplicates.description: Google's duplicate-content filter (default on). false returns near-duplicate results too.

include_pagemap.description: Attach each result's raw pagemap (OpenGraph/metatags/thumbnails and other structured page data). Verbose — leave off unless you need page metadata.

interface_language.description: Interface language used to interpret the query, e.g. "de". Improves non-English relevance.

language.description: Only results in this language, e.g. "en", "de", "zh-CN".

or_terms.description: Space-separated words — each result must contain at least one of them.

query.description: The search query, Google syntax included (quotes, site:, filetype:, OR, -exclusions).

rights.description: License filter: cc_publicdomain, cc_attribute, cc_sharealike, cc_noncommercial, cc_nonderived (combine with |).

safe.description: Safe search: active filters adult content, off (the API default) does not.

site_search.description: A site or domain to include or exclude, e.g. "example.com" — pair with site_search_filter.

site_search_filter.description: include = only results from site_search, exclude = everything but it. Default include.

sort.description: Sort expression, e.g. "date" for newest-first. Omit for relevance (usually better).

start.description: 1-based index of the first result — use next_start/previous_start from the previous page. The API serves at most 100 results per query, so start + num - 1 must stay <= 100 (enforced: a wider window is rejected without spending quota).

name: search
title: Web search
